architecture-decision-record.purpose: single architecturally significant decision with context, options, consequences, authority and AD traceability
architecture-decision-record.blank_rule: print-ready unapproved decision form, never an accepted decision
architecture-decision-record.validation: identity, status, alternatives, rationale, consequences, supersession, evidence and links

architecture-description.purpose: versioned architecture expression for an entity of interest and its stakeholder concerns
architecture-description.blank_rule: preserve EoI, stakeholder, concern, viewpoint, view, component, correspondence and rationale coverage
architecture-description.validation: baseline, stakeholder-concern coverage, views, model kinds, correspondences, inconsistencies and essential decisions

architecture-viewpoint.purpose: reusable conventions for building and interpreting architecture views
architecture-viewpoint.blank_rule: preserve specification of concerns, model kinds, methods, interpretation and correspondence; no worked examples or bracketed prompts
architecture-viewpoint.validation: viewpoint identity, intended concerns, stakeholders, model kinds, view methods, correspondence methods, source provenance

classification_policy.policy_note: These are local repository governance rules informed by ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022. ADR format, immutability and Template–Blank pairing are not prescribed by ISO 42010.
